::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 7th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 60
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
Please to let me correct two things in the list of presentation copies of the [Golden Deeds](cmy_books/cmybook_51.qmd)

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

Miss [Margaret Lonsdale](people/person_896.qmd)
28 Westbourne Terrace W

Miss [Charlotte Fursdon](people/person_534.qmd) 
Fursdon 
Cadbury
Tiverton
